Daniel 4:34: At the completion of the seven years, the time of my release came. My sins and my acts of ignorance reached their full measure before the God of heaven. Daniel 4:37: I give thanks to the Most High and praise Him who created heaven and earth, seas and rivers, and everything in them. He performs signs and wonders and changes seasons and times, taking kingdoms from kings and appointing others in their place.
Daniel 4:37a: From now on I will worship Him. Trembling has seized me through fear of Him, and I praise all His holy ones. Daniel 4:37c: “King Nebuchadnezzar to all nations, all countries, and all who dwell in them: May peace be multiplied to you at every time.
